notes.title: Upcoming New Season
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42227834/a5f6700eaf1cd74fe5a3a82d3bdcf3f2c49cd07c.png[/img]We continue our work for the second season. You'll see that we've built the game from the ground up in the next major update since MEARTH's debut. Everything has been redesigned and improved, the mechanics have been improved and the soft character has been designed in high resolution and according to your comments. Stay tuned, you can buy the game to support it, we'll be back with a big update on September 16th.

notes.title: Upcoming Big Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,
As a result of your feedback, new mechanics, high-definition customizable main character (no longer wearing masks) and many new game systems will come with the second season. This update will come with season 2. We are working hard on it. New mechanics have been tested and are being integrated into the game. Stay tuned for a big update coming soon.
Have Fun!

notes.title: Sorry for your bad experience.
notes.notes: It seems that we have increased the difficulty of the game too much. We realized this and updated it again. The game is currently in Beta version, if you have any errors or difficulties, contact us. You can easily reach us on social media.

notes.title: Description of the game
notes.notes: The production phase of the game took 6 months and was made with a single-person team. Therefore, you may encounter mistakes and bugs while playing season 1. In such cases, please contact us. You can always contact us for your requests, suggestions and complaints. Our Vision: What makes a game a game is the permanence of the players who play the game and the enjoyment of the players. Players build a game, developers lay the foundation. That's why you can convey your expectations for the upcoming seasons both on the community page and by contacting us. I wish everyone good games.
